newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spotless says knows no reason for rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spotless says knows no reason for rise.

text.p: Plastic and diversified services group Spotless Group Ltd told the Australian Stock Exchange on Tuesday that it had no information that might explain recent rises in its share price except for the strength of listed subsidiary Spotless Services Ltd.

In response to an ASX letter querying a 15-cent price rise on Monday, when the stock closed at A$2.45, company secretary Graham Hotton said no matters of importance were about to be announced to shareholders and the market.
